title: Best of Leh
shortDescription: Embark on a magical journey through breathtaking scenery, stark landscapes and unique monuments nestled in the mighty Himalayas. Encounter the hardworking and hospitable people and learn about their lives.
description: Embark on a magical journey through breathtaking scenery, stark landscapes and unique monuments nestled in the mighty Himalayas. Encounter the hardworking and hospitable people and learn about their lives. Visit the unique Magnetic Hill and Druk Padma Karpo School (Rancho’s school from 3 Idiots). Marvel at the turquoise waters of Pangong Lake and the unique architecture of stupas and monasteries that dot the villages of this fascinating place.
